title: Opening a Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account and the Plan It Carries
content:
**Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account: opening rules.**

1. A worker holds at most 1 payroll card account. Loads from a second employer's Payroll Card Program post to the same account. The account's plan stays the one set by the program it was opened under.
2. A worker may not hold a second card account that is not closed.
3. An account is opened only under an employer Payroll Card Program whose status is live.
4. An account is opened only when the worker's written, voluntary consent to receive wages on the card is on file, recorded as the payroll consent date.
5. Under Regulation E no employer may require a worker to be paid on a payroll card as a condition of employment. A worker who has not consented, or who prefers direct deposit or a paper check, is paid that way instead, and no account is opened.
6. The account opens in issued status with a zero balance and no block reason. Its plan matches the employer's Payroll Card Program package as listed below. It has no first deposit date until a load posts.

## Plan by employer package

| Employer's Paystride Payroll Card Program package | Plan of the account |
|---|---|
| Paystride Paycard Program Essential | Paystride Visa Payroll Card Essential |
| Paystride Paycard Program Standard | Paystride Visa Payroll Card Standard |
| Paystride Paycard Program Select | Paystride Visa Payroll Card Select |
| Paystride Paycard Program Advantage | Paystride Visa Payroll Card Advantage |
| Paystride Paycard Program Premier | Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier |
| Paystride Paycard Program Elite | Paystride Visa Payroll Card Elite |

Every plan also requires the opt-in consent to be on file.

## What the records must show

| Condition | Shown by |
|---|---|
| no other card account that is not closed | the worker's card accounts and their status |
| the program is live | the status of the employer's Payroll Card Program |
| consent on file | a payroll consent date on the record |

A worker's statement that they consented does not stand in for the recorded consent date.

## Hypothetical cases

- A worker whose only earlier card account is closed, employed under a live Select program, with consent recorded: an account opens on the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Select plan.
- The same worker with an earlier account still blocked: no second account opens.
- A worker of a live program with no consent on file: no account opens, and the worker is paid by direct deposit or paper check.
